summary: Banzai International filed an 8-K/A reporting a debt-for-equity exchange with Agile Capital Funding. The company exchanged 232,786 shares of Class A common stock valued at $1.22/share ($284,000 aggregate) to reduce its subordinated secured promissory note balance from ~$1.495M to $1.839M after adding a $628,058 forbearance fee. The forbearance agreement temporarily waives defaults through March 30, 2026. This restructuring avoids immediate creditor enforcement while modifying loan terms. Watch for further exchanges or potential default if the company cannot meet revised obligations; risk-arb focuses on equity dilution versus debt reduction sustainability.
